description: Real.__float__ converts a REAL value (mantissa, base, exponent) by first computing the integer mantissa * base ** exponent. The exponent of a decoded value is chosen by the sender, so a base-10 value with an exponent in the hundreds of millions makes float(), and everything that calls it such as prettyPrint(), build a number with hundreds of millions of digits before failing.

finding.message: Float conversion materialises base ** exponent as an integer for any exponent.
